guides.title: Christmas lights
guides.intro: The best holiday light displays in and around San Diego this season, with 2026 dates checked against the organizers and local guides.

items.name: Lightscape
items.blurb: A one-mile night loop of light art through the gardens, with new installations this year.
items.blurbEs: Un recorrido nocturno de una milla con arte de luz entre los jardines.

items.name: Holiday Wonderland at Petco Park
items.blurb: Lights, nightly snowfall, a 40-foot tree, a carousel, a train and a snow sledding hill.
items.blurbEs: Luces, nieve cada noche, un árbol de 40 pies, carrusel, tren y una colina de nieve.

items.name: Coastal Christmas Holiday Lights Spectacular
items.addr: 2260 Jimmy Durante Blvd, Del Mar, CA 92014
items.blurb: A winter-themed light display by the coast with food and drinks.
items.blurbEs: Un espectáculo de luces invernal junto a la costa, con comida y bebidas.

items.name: Little Italy Tree Lighting & Christmas Village
items.addr: Piazza della Famiglia, India St & W Date St, San Diego, CA 92101
items.blurb: Street-wide twinkle lights, giant nutcrackers and a tree lighting in the piazza.
items.blurbEs: Luces en toda la calle, cascanueces gigantes y el encendido del árbol en la plaza.

guides.title: Holiday markets
guides.intro: Where to shop local for the holidays in San Diego: Christmas markets, makers fairs and holiday villages running this season.

items.name: Little Italy Christmas Village
items.addr: India St & W Date St, San Diego, CA 92101
items.blurb: A one-day Christmas village along the neighborhood's main street.
items.blurbEs: Un pueblo navideño de un día en la calle principal del barrio.

items.name: SoNo Fest & Chili Cook-Off
items.addr: 30th St & Juniper St, San Diego, CA 92104
items.blurb: Holiday shopping on the neighborhood's streets, with craft beer, wine, music and chili.
items.blurbEs: Compras navideñas en las calles del barrio, con cerveza artesanal, vino, música y chili.

items.name: Holiday in the Village
items.addr: La Mesa Blvd, La Mesa, CA 91942
items.blurb: Dozens of local craft stands, artisan food, fire pits and caroling.
items.blurbEs: Decenas de puestos de artesanías, comida artesanal, fogatas y villancicos.

items.name: Christmas in the Park
items.blurb: A tree lighting, Santa, train rides, live music and crafts.
items.blurbEs: Encendido del árbol, Santa, paseos en tren, música en vivo y artesanías.
